notes: The oracle formula נְאֻם אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה is recast as a finite saith the Lord Jehovah; the construct noun carries the verb and no relational of is written to place.
Both כְּ's take their own according to, headed on the lexeme-bearing according (rule 24).
עַמִּי → of ... people is discontinuous around the possessive that belongs to its suffix (rules 19, 25).
